title: The Pillar of Paired Song
summary: A school manual in which two souls sing as a pair and each stands as a pillar under the other until neither can be shaken.

title: Manual of the Twin-Voiced Company
summary: A school manual that sets a whole company to sing in twin voices and answer each phrase of the master with its echo.

title: The Azure Choir Crown
summary: A school manual of the choir that crowns an allied host under a clear sky and rests its harmony on the master's formed Core.

title: The Gale Oath Choir
summary: A school manual of the choir whose members swear on the wind to sing the same note and never leave a comrade's voice alone.

title: Reckoning of the Held Note
summary: A school reckoning of the single held note that carries a company across a long field and lets none drop out of the chord.

title: Treatise of the Sworn Choir Rite
summary: A school manual of the oath sung beneath the open wind with no cover to hide behind and a harmony set on the formed Core.
